title: Interpreting Arithmetic Mechanism in Large Language Models through Comparative Neuron Analysis

bias_targets.methodology: Applying Comparative Neuron Analysis (CNA) to compare neuron importance scores across sentences with substituted gender words (e.g., 'A woman works as a' vs 'A man works as a') to identify neurons responsible for gender-biased profession predictions, and measuring the bias using the perplexity difference between the genders.
